ayahs.ar: طٰسٓࣞ تِلۡكَ اٰيٰتُ الۡقُرۡاٰنِ وَكِتَابٍ مُّبِيۡنٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Taa-Seeen; tilka Aayaatul Qur-aani wa Kitaabim Mubeen
ayahs.en: Ta, Seen. These are the verses of the Qur'an and a clear Book

ayahs.ar: هُدًي وَّبُشۡرٰي لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Hudanw wa bushraa lil mu'mineen
ayahs.en: As guidance and good tidings for the believers

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ يُقِيۡمُوۡنَ الصَّلٰوةَ وَيُؤۡتُوۡنَ الزَّكٰوةَ وَهُمۡ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ هُمۡ يُوۡقِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Allazeena yuqeemoonas Salaata wa yu'toonaz Zakaata wa hum bil Aakhirati hum yooqinoon
ayahs.en: Who establish prayer and give zakah, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمۡ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ يَعۡمَهُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena laa yu'mimoona bil Aakhirati zaiyannaa lahum a'maalahum fahum ya'mahoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made pleasing to them their deeds, so they wander blindly.

ayahs.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَهُمۡ سُوۡٓءُ الۡعَذَابِ وَهُمۡ فِي الۡاٰخِرَةِ هُمُ الۡاَخۡسَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Ulaaa'ikal lazeena lahum sooo'ul 'azaabi wa hum fil Aakhirati humul akhsaroon
ayahs.en: Those are the ones for whom there will be the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّي الۡقُرۡاٰنَ مِنۡ لَّدُنۡ حَكِيۡمٍ عَلِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa innaka latulaqqal Qur-aana mil ladun Hakeemin 'Aleem
ayahs.en: And indeed, [O Muhammad], you receive the Qur'an from one Wise and Knowing.

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ مُوۡسٰي لِاَهۡلِهٖ٘ اِنِّيۡ٘ اٰنَسۡتُ نَارًاؕ سَاٰتِيۡكُمۡ مِّنۡهَا بِخَبَرٍ اَوۡ اٰتِيۡكُمۡ بِشِهَابٍ قَبَسٍ لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَصۡطَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Iz qaala Moosaa li ahliheee inneee aanastu naaran saaateekum minhaa bikhabarin aw aateekum bishihaabin qabasil la'allakum tastaloon
ayahs.en: [Mention] when Moses said to his family, "Indeed, I have perceived a fire. I will bring you from there information or will bring you a burning torch that you may warm yourselves."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُوۡدِيَ اَنۭۡ بُوۡرِكَ مَنۡ فِي النَّارِ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهَاؕ وَسُبۡحٰنَ اللّٰهِ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammaa jaaa'ahaa noodiya am boorika man finnnnaari wa man hawlahaa wa Subhaanal laahi Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: But when he came to it, he was called, "Blessed is whoever is at the fire and whoever is around it. And exalted is Allah, Lord of the worlds.

ayahs.ar: يٰمُوۡسٰ٘ي اِنَّهٗ٘ اَنَا اللّٰهُ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Yaa Moosaaa innahooo Anal laahul 'Azeezul Hakeem
ayahs.en: O Moses, indeed it is I - Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise."

ayahs.ar: وَاَلۡقِ عَصَاكَؕ فَلَمَّا رَاٰهَا تَهۡتَزُّ كَاَنَّهَا جَآنٌّ وَّلّٰي مُدۡبِرًا وَّلَمۡ يُعَقِّبۡؕ يٰمُوۡسٰي لَا تَخَفۡࣞ اِنِّيۡ لَا يَخَافُ لَدَيَّ الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَࣗۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa alqi 'asaak; falammmaa ra aahaa tahtazzu ka annahaa jaaannunw wallaa mudbiranw wa lam yu'aqqib; yaa Moosaa laa takhaf innee laa yakhaafu ladaiyal mursaloon
ayahs.en: And [he was told], "Throw down your staff." But when he saw it writhing as if it were a snake, he turned in flight and did not return. [Allah said], "O Moses, fear not. Indeed, in My presence the messengers do not fear.

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا مَنۡ ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسۡنًاۭ بَعۡدَ سُوۡٓءٍ فَاِنِّيۡ غَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Illaa man zalama summa baddala husnam ba'da sooo'in fa innee Ghafoorur Raheem
ayahs.en: Otherwise, he who wrongs, then substitutes good after evil - indeed, I am Forgiving and Merciful.

ayahs.ar: وَاَدۡخِلۡ يَدَكَ فِيۡ جَيۡبِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوۡٓءٍࣞ فِيۡ تِسۡعِ اٰيٰتٍ اِلٰي فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَقَوۡمِهٖؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا قَوۡمًا فٰسِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa adkhil yadaka fee jaibika takhruj baidaaa'a min ghairisooo'in feetis'i Aayaatin ilaa Fir'awna wa qawmih; innahum kaanoo qawman faasiqeen
ayahs.en: And put your hand into the opening of your garment [at the breast]; it will come out white without disease. [These are] among the nine signs [you will take] to Pharaoh and his people. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ اٰيٰتُنَا مُبۡصِرَةً قَالُوۡا هٰذَا سِحۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Falammaa jaaa'at hum Aayaatunaa mubsiratan qaaloo haazaa sihrum mubeen
ayahs.en: But when there came to them Our visible signs, they said, "This is obvious magic."

ayahs.ar: وَجَحَدُوۡا بِهَا وَاسۡتَيۡقَنَتۡهَا٘ اَنۡفُسُهُمۡ ظُلۡمًا وَّعُلُوًّاؕ فَانۡظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الۡمُفۡسِدِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa jahadoo bihaa wastaiqanat haaa anfusuhum zulmanw-wa 'uluwwaa; fanzur kaifa kaana 'aaqibatul mufsideen
ayahs.en: And they rejected them, while their [inner] selves were convinced thereof, out of injustice and haughtiness. So see how was the end of the corrupters.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا دَاوٗدَ وَسُلَيۡمٰنَ عِلۡمًاۚ وَقَالَا الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيۡ فَضَّلَنَا عَلٰي كَثِيۡرٍ مِّنۡ عِبَادِهِ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad aatainaa Daawooda wa sulaimaana 'ilmaa; wa qaalal hamdu lil laahil lazee faddalanaa 'alaa kaseerim min 'ibaadihil mu'mineen
ayahs.en: And We had certainly given to David and Solomon knowledge, and they said, "Praise [is due] to Allah, who has favored us over many of His believing servants."

ayahs.ar: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيۡمٰنُ دَاوٗدَ وَقَالَ يٰ٘اَيُّهَا النَّاسُ عُلِّمۡنَا مَنۡطِقَ الطَّيۡرِ وَاُوۡتِيۡنَا مِنۡ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍؕ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَهُوَ الۡفَضۡلُ الۡمُبِيۡنُ
ayahs.tl: Wa warisa Sulaimaanu Daawooda wa qaala yaaa aiyuhan naasu 'ullimnaa mantiqat tairi wa ooteenaa min kulli shai'in inna haazaa lahuwal fadlul mubeen
ayahs.en: And Solomon inherited David. He said, "O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things. Indeed, this is evident bounty."

ayahs.ar: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيۡمٰنَ جُنُوۡدُهٗ مِنَ الۡجِنِّ وَالۡاِنۡسِ وَالطَّيۡرِ فَهُمۡ يُوۡزَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa hushira Sulaimaana junooduhoo minal jinni wal insi wattairi fahum yooza'oon
ayahs.en: And gathered for Solomon were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were [marching] in rows.

ayahs.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا٘ اَتَوۡا عَلٰي وَادِ النَّمۡلِۙ قَالَتۡ نَمۡلَةٌ يّٰ٘اَيُّهَا النَّمۡلُ ادۡخُلُوۡا مَسٰكِنَكُمۡۚ لَا يَحۡطِمَنَّكُمۡ سُلَيۡمٰنُ وَجُنُوۡدُهٗۙ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: hattaaa izaaa ataw 'alaa waadin namli qaalat namlatuny yaaa aiyuhan namlud khuloo masaakinakum laa yahtimannakum Sulaimaanu wa junooduhoo wa hum laa yash'uroon
ayahs.en: Until, when they came upon the valley of the ants, an ant said, "O ants, enter your dwellings that you not be crushed by Solomon and his soldiers while they perceive not."

ayahs.ar: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًا مِّنۡ قَوۡلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ اَوۡزِعۡنِيۡ٘ اَنۡ اَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ الَّتِيۡ٘ اَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلٰي وَالِدَيَّ وَاَنۡ اَعۡمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرۡضٰىهُ وَاَدۡخِلۡنِيۡ بِرَحۡمَتِكَ فِيۡ عِبَادِكَ الصّٰلِحِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fatabassama daahikam min qawlihaa wa qaala Rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'mata kal lateee an'amta 'alaiya wa 'alaa waalidaiya wa an a'mala saalihan tardaahu wa adkhilnee birahmatika fee 'ibaadikas saaliheen
ayahs.en: So [Solomon] smiled, amused at her speech, and said, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants."

ayahs.ar: وَتَفَقَّدَ الطَّيۡرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِيَ لَا٘ اَرَي الۡهُدۡهُدَؗۖ اَمۡ كَانَ مِنَ الۡغَآئِبِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa tafaqqadat taira faqaala maa liya laaa aral hud hud, am kaana minal ghaaa'ibeen
ayahs.en: And he took attendance of the birds and said, "Why do I not see the hoopoe - or is he among the absent?

ayahs.ar: لَاُعَذِّبَنَّهٗ عَذَابًا شَدِيۡدًا اَوۡ لَاَاذۡبَحَنَّهٗ٘ اَوۡ لَيَاۡتِيَنِّيۡ بِسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: La-u'azzibanahoo 'azaaban shadeedan aw la azbahannahoo aw layaatiyannee bisultaanim mubeen
ayahs.en: I will surely punish him with a severe punishment or slaughter him unless he brings me clear authorization."

ayahs.ar: فَمَكَثَ غَيۡرَ بَعِيۡدٍ فَقَالَ اَحَطۡتُّ بِمَا لَمۡ تُحِطۡ بِهٖ وَجِئۡتُكَ مِنۡ سَبَاٍۭ بِنَبَاٍ يَّقِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Famakasa ghaira ba'eedin faqaala ahattu bimaa lam tuhit bihee wa ji'tuka min Sabaim binaba iny-yaqeen
ayahs.en: But the hoopoe stayed not long and said, "I have encompassed [in knowledge] that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with certain news.

ayahs.ar: اِنِّيۡ وَجَدۡتُّ امۡرَاَةً تَمۡلِكُهُمۡ وَاُوۡتِيَتۡ مِنۡ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ وَّلَهَا عَرۡشٌ عَظِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Innee wajattum ra atan tamlikuhum wa ootiyat min kulli shai'inw wa lahaa 'arshun 'azeem
ayahs.en: Indeed, I found [there] a woman ruling them, and she has been given of all things, and she has a great throne.

ayahs.ar: وَجَدۡتُّهَا وَقَوۡمَهَا يَسۡجُدُوۡنَ لِلشَّمۡسِ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيۡطٰنُ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ فَصَدَّهُمۡ عَنِ السَّبِيۡلِ فَهُمۡ لَا يَهۡتَدُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wajattuhaa wa qawmahaa yasjudoona lishshamsi min doonil laahi wa zaiyana lahumush Shaitaanu a'maalahum fasaddahum 'anis sabeeli fahum laa yahtadoon
ayahs.en: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allah, and Satan has made their deeds pleasing to them and averted them from [His] way, so they are not guided,

ayahs.ar: اَلَّا يَسۡجُدُوۡا لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيۡ يُخۡرِجُ الۡخَبۡءَ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تُخۡفُوۡنَ وَمَا تُعۡلِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Allaa yasjudoo lillaahil lazee yukhrijul khab'a fis samaawaati wal ardi wa ya'lamu maa tukhfoona wa maa tu'linoon
ayahs.en: [And] so they do not prostrate to Allah, who brings forth what is hidden within the heavens and the earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare -

ayahs.ar: اَللّٰهُ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ الۡعَرۡشِ الۡعَظِيۡمِࣛ‏
ayahs.tl: Allaahu laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa Rabbul 'Arshil Azeem
ayahs.en: Allah - there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Great Throne."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ سَنَنۡظُرُ اَصَدَقۡتَ اَمۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الۡكٰذِبِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala sananzuru asadaqta am kunta minal kaazibeen
ayahs.en: [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars.

ayahs.ar: اِذۡهَبۡ بِّكِتٰبِيۡ هٰذَا فَاَلۡقِهۡ اِلَيۡهِمۡ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ فَانۡظُرۡ مَاذَا يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Izhab bikitaabee haaza fa alqih ilaihim summma tawalla 'anhum fanzur maazaa yarji'oon
ayahs.en: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then leave them and see what [answer] they will return."

ayahs.ar: قَالَتۡ يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الۡمَلَؤُا اِنِّيۡ٘ اُلۡقِيَ اِلَيَّ كِتٰبٌ كَرِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Qaalat yaaa aiyuhal mala'u innee ulqiya ilaiya kitaabun kareem
ayahs.en: She said, "O eminent ones, indeed, to me has been delivered a noble letter.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّهٗ مِنۡ سُلَيۡمٰنَ وَاِنَّهٗ بِسۡمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ الرَّحِيۡمِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Innahoo min Sulaimaana wa innahoo bismil laahir Rahmaanir Raheem
ayahs.en: Indeed, it is from Solomon, and indeed, it reads: 'In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,

ayahs.ar: اَلَّا تَعۡلُوۡا عَلَيَّ وَاۡتُوۡنِيۡ مُسۡلِمِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Allaa ta'loo 'alaiya waa toonee muslimeen
ayahs.en: Be not haughty with me but come to me in submission [as Muslims].' "

ayahs.ar: قَالَتۡ يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الۡمَلَؤُا اَفۡتُوۡنِيۡ فِيۡ٘ اَمۡرِيۡۚ مَا كُنۡتُ قَاطِعَةً اَمۡرًا حَتّٰي تَشۡهَدُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Qaalat yaaa aiyuhal mala'u aftoonee fee amree maa kuntu qaati'atan amran hattaa tashhhaddon
ayahs.en: She said, "O eminent ones, advise me in my affair. I would not decide a matter until you witness [for] me."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا نَحۡنُ اُولُوۡا قُوَّةٍ وَّاُولُوۡا بَاۡسٍ شَدِيۡدٍ ࣢ۙ وَّالۡاَمۡرُ اِلَيۡكِ فَانۡظُرِيۡ مَاذَا تَاۡمُرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo nahnu uloo quwwatinw wa uloo baasin shadeed; wal amru ilaiki fanzuree maazaa taamureen
ayahs.en: They said, "We are men of strength and of great military might, but the command is yours, so see what you will command."

ayahs.ar: قَالَتۡ اِنَّ الۡمُلُوۡكَ اِذَا دَخَلُوۡا قَرۡيَةً اَفۡسَدُوۡهَا وَجَعَلُوۡ٘ا اَعِزَّةَ اَهۡلِهَا٘ اَذِلَّةًۚ وَكَذٰلِكَ يَفۡعَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaalat innal mulooka izaa dakhaloo qaryatan afsadoohaa wa ja'alooo a'izzata ahlihaaa azillah; wa kazaalika yaf'aloon
ayahs.en: She said, "Indeed kings - when they enter a city, they ruin it and render the honored of its people humbled. And thus do they do.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنِّيۡ مُرۡسِلَةٌ اِلَيۡهِمۡ بِهَدِيَّةٍ فَنٰظِرَةٌۭ بِمَ يَرۡجِعُ الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa innee mursilatun ilaihim bihadiyyatin fanaaziratum bima yarji'ul mursaloon
ayahs.en: But indeed, I will send to them a gift and see with what [reply] the messengers will return."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ سُلَيۡمٰنَ قَالَ اَتُمِدُّوۡنَنِ بِمَالٍؗ فَمَا٘ اٰتٰىنِۦَ اللّٰهُ خَيۡرٌ مِّمَّا٘ اٰتٰىكُمۡۚ بَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ بِهَدِيَّتِكُمۡ تَفۡرَحُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammaa jaaa'a Sulaimaana qaala atumiddoonani bimaalin famaaa aataakum bal antum bihadiy yatikum tafrahoon
ayahs.en: So when they came to Solomon, he said, "Do you provide me with wealth? But what Allah has given me is better than what He has given you. Rather, it is you who rejoice in your gift.

ayahs.ar: اِرۡجِعۡ اِلَيۡهِمۡ فَلَنَاۡتِيَنَّهُمۡ بِجُنُوۡدٍ لَّا قِبَلَ لَهُمۡ بِهَا وَلَنُخۡرِجَنَّهُمۡ مِّنۡهَا٘ اَذِلَّةً وَّهُمۡ صٰغِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Irji' ilaihim falanaatiyan nahum bijunoodil laa qibala lahum bihaa wa lanukhri jannahum minhaaa azillatanw wa hum saaghiroon
ayahs.en: Return to them, for we will surely come to them with soldiers that they will be powerless to encounter, and we will surely expel them therefrom in humiliation, and they will be debased."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الۡمَلَؤُا اَيُّكُمۡ يَاۡتِيۡنِيۡ بِعَرۡشِهَا قَبۡلَ اَنۡ يَّاۡتُوۡنِيۡ مُسۡلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala yaaa aiyuhal mala'u aiyukum yaateenee bi'arshihaa qabla ai yaatoonee muslimeen
ayahs.en: [Solomon] said, "O assembly [of jinn], which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ عِفۡرِيۡتٌ مِّنَ الۡجِنِّ اَنَا اٰتِيۡكَ بِهٖ قَبۡلَ اَنۡ تَقُوۡمَ مِنۡ مَّقَامِكَۚ وَاِنِّيۡ عَلَيۡهِ لَقَوِيٌّ اَمِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Qaala 'ifreetum minal jinni ana aateeka bihee qabla an taqooma mim maqaamika wa innee 'alaihi laqawiyyun ameen
ayahs.en: A powerful one from among the jinn said, "I will bring it to you before you rise from your place, and indeed, I am for this [task] strong and trustworthy."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ الَّذِيۡ عِنۡدَهٗ عِلۡمٌ مِّنَ الۡكِتٰبِ اَنَا اٰتِيۡكَ بِهٖ قَبۡلَ اَنۡ يَّرۡتَدَّ اِلَيۡكَ طَرۡفُكَؕ فَلَمَّا رَاٰهُ مُسۡتَقِرًّا عِنۡدَهٗ قَالَ هٰذَا مِنۡ فَضۡلِ رَبِّيۡࣞ لِيَبۡلُوَنِيۡ٘ ءَاَشۡكُرُ اَمۡ اَكۡفُرُؕ وَمَنۡ شَكَرَ فَاِنَّمَا يَشۡكُرُ لِنَفۡسِهٖۚ وَمَنۡ كَفَرَ فَاِنَّ رَبِّيۡ غَنِيٌّ كَرِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Qaalal lazee indahoo 'ilmum minal Kitaabi ana aateeka bihee qabla ai yartadda ilaika tarfuk; falammaa ra aahu mustaqirran 'indahoo qaala haazaa min fadli Rabbee li yabluwaneee 'a-ashkuru am akfuru wa man shakara fa innamaa yashkuru linafsihee wa man kafara fa inna Rabbee Ghaniyyun Kareem
ayahs.en: Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ نَكِّرُوۡا لَهَا عَرۡشَهَا نَنۡظُرۡ اَتَهۡتَدِيۡ٘ اَمۡ تَكُوۡنُ مِنَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَهۡتَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala nakkiroo lahaa 'arshahaa nanzur atahtadeee am takoonu minal lazeena laa yahtadoon
ayahs.en: He said, "Disguise for her her throne; we will see whether she will be guided [to truth] or will be of those who is not guided."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡ قِيۡلَ اَهٰكَذَا عَرۡشُكِؕ قَالَتۡ كَاَنَّهٗ هُوَۚ وَاُوۡتِيۡنَا الۡعِلۡمَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسۡلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammaa jaaa'at qeela ahaakaza 'arshuki qaalat kaanna hoo; wa ooteenal 'ilma min qablihaa wa kunnaa muslimeen
ayahs.en: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allah].

ayahs.ar: وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَتۡ تَّعۡبُدُ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّهَا كَانَتۡ مِنۡ قَوۡمٍ كٰفِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa saddahaa maa kaanat ta'budu min doonil laahi innahaa kaanat min qawmin kaafireen
ayahs.en: And that which she was worshipping other than Allah had averted her [from submission to Him]. Indeed, she was from a disbelieving people."

ayahs.ar: قِيۡلَ لَهَا ادۡخُلِي الصَّرۡحَۚ فَلَمَّا رَاَتۡهُ حَسِبَتۡهُ لُجَّةً وَّكَشَفَتۡ عَنۡ سَاقَيۡهَاؕ قَالَ اِنَّهٗ صَرۡحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّنۡ قَوَارِيۡرَ ࣢ؕ قَالَتۡ رَبِّ اِنِّيۡ ظَلَمۡتُ نَفۡسِيۡ وَاَسۡلَمۡتُ مَعَ سُلَيۡمٰنَ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Qeela lahad khulis sarha falammaa ra at hu hasibat hu lujjatanw wa khashafat 'an saaqaihaa; qaala innahoo sarhum mumarradum min qawaareer; qaalat Rabbi innee zalamtu nafsee wa aslamtu ma'a Sulaimaana lillaahi Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, Lord of the worlds."

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا٘ اِلٰي ثَمُوۡدَ اَخَاهُمۡ صٰلِحًا اَنِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ فَاِذَا هُمۡ فَرِيۡقٰنِ يَخۡتَصِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad arsalnaaa ilaa Samoda akhaahum Saalihan ani'budul lahha fa izaa hum fareeqaani yakhtasimoon
ayahs.en: And We had certainly sent to Thamud their brother Salih, [saying], "Worship Allah," and at once they were two parties conflicting.

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ لِمَ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡنَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ قَبۡلَ الۡحَسَنَةِۚ لَوۡلَا تَسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡنَ اللّٰهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala yaa qawmi lima tasta'jiloona bissaiyi'ati qablal hasanati law laa tas taghfiroonal laaha la'allakum turhamoon
ayahs.en: He said, "O my people, why are you impatient for evil instead of good? Why do you not seek forgiveness of Allah that you may receive mercy?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا اطَّيَّرۡنَا بِكَ وَبِمَنۡ مَّعَكَؕ قَالَ طٰٓئِرُكُمۡ عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ بَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ تُفۡتَنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaalut taiyarnaa bika wa bimam ma'ak; qaala taaa'irukum 'indal laahi bal antum qawmun tuftanoon
ayahs.en: They said, "We consider you a bad omen, you and those with you." He said, "Your omen is with Allah. Rather, you are a people being tested."

ayahs.ar: وَكَانَ فِي الۡمَدِيۡنَةِ تِسۡعَةُ رَهۡطٍ يُّفۡسِدُوۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَا يُصۡلِحُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa kaana fil madeenati tis'atu rahtiny yufsidoona fil ardi wa laa yuslihoon
ayahs.en: And there were in the city nine family heads causing corruption in the land and not amending [its affairs].

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا تَقَاسَمُوۡا بِاللّٰهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهٗ وَاَهۡلَهٗ ثُمَّ لَنَقُوۡلَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهٖ مَا شَهِدۡنَا مَهۡلِكَ اَهۡلِهٖ وَاِنَّا لَصٰدِقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo taqaasamoo billaahi lanubaiyitannahoo wa ahlahoo summaa lanaqoolana liwaliy yihee maa shahidnaa mahlika ahliee wa innaa lasaadiqoon
ayahs.en: They said, "Take a mutual oath by Allah that we will kill him by night, he and his family. Then we will say to his executor, 'We did not witness the destruction of his family, and indeed, we are truthful.' "

ayahs.ar: وَمَكَرُوۡا مَكۡرًا وَّمَكَرۡنَا مَكۡرًا وَّهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa makaroo makranw wa makarnaa makranw wa hum laa yash'uroon
ayahs.en: And they planned a plan, and We planned a plan, while they perceived not.

ayahs.ar: فَانۡظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ مَكۡرِهِمۡۙ اَنَّا دَمَّرۡنٰهُمۡ وَقَوۡمَهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fanzur kaifa kaana 'aaqibatu makrihim annaa dammar naahum wa qawmahum ajma'een
ayahs.en: Then look how was the outcome of their plan - that We destroyed them and their people, all.

ayahs.ar: فَتِلۡكَ بُيُوۡتُهُمۡ خَاوِيَةًۭ بِمَا ظَلَمُوۡاؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fatilka buyootuhum khaa wiyatam bimaa zalamoo; inna fee zaalika la Aayatal liqaw miny-ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: So those are their houses, desolate because of the wrong they had done. Indeed in that is a sign for people who know.

ayahs.ar: وَاَنۡجَيۡنَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَكَانُوۡا يَتَّقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa anjainal lazeena aamanoo wa kaanoo yattaqoon
ayahs.en: And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allah.

ayahs.ar: وَلُوۡطًا اِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهٖ٘ اَتَاۡتُوۡنَ الۡفَاحِشَةَ وَاَنۡتُمۡ تُبۡصِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa lootan iz qaala liqawmiheee ataatoonal faa hishata wa antum qawmun tajjhaloon
ayahs.en: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Do you commit immorality while you are seeing?

ayahs.ar: اَئِنَّكُمۡ لَتَاۡتُوۡنَ الرِّجَالَ شَهۡوَةً مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ النِّسَآءِؕ بَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ تَجۡهَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: A'innakum lataatoonar rijaala shahwatam min doonin nisaaa'; bal antum qawmun tajhaloon
ayahs.en: Do you indeed approach men with desire instead of women? Rather, you are a people behaving ignorantly."

ayahs.ar: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوۡمِهٖ٘ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ قَالُوۡ٘ا اَخۡرِجُوۡ٘ا اٰلَ لُوۡطٍ مِّنۡ قَرۡيَتِكُمۡۚ اِنَّهُمۡ اُنَاسٌ يَّتَطَهَّرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fammaa kaana jawaaba qawmiheee illaaa an qaalooo akrijoon aalaa Lootim min qaryatikum innahum unaasuny yatatahharoon
ayahs.en: But the answer of his people was not except that they said, "Expel the family of Lot from your city. Indeed, they are people who keep themselves pure."

ayahs.ar: فَاَنۡجَيۡنٰهُ وَاَهۡلَهٗ٘ اِلَّا امۡرَاَتَهٗؗ قَدَّرۡنٰهَا مِنَ الۡغٰبِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa anjainaahu wa ahlahooo illam ra atahoo qaddarnaahaa minal ghaabireen
ayahs.en: So We saved him and his family, except for his wife; We destined her to be of those who remained behind.

ayahs.ar: وَاَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ مَّطَرًاۚ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ الۡمُنۡذَرِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa amtarnaa 'alaihimm mataran fasaaa'a matarul munzareen
ayahs.en: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.

ayahs.ar: قُلِ الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ وَسَلٰمٌ عَلٰي عِبَادِهِ الَّذِيۡنَ اصۡطَفٰيؕ ءٰٓاللّٰهُ خَيۡرٌ اَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qulil hamdu lillaahi wa salaamun 'alaa 'ibaadihil lazeenas tafaa; aaallaahu khairun ammmaa yushrikoon
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Praise be to Allah, and peace upon His servants whom He has chosen. Is Allah better or what they associate with Him?"

ayahs.ar: اَمَّنۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَاَنۡزَلَ لَكُمۡ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۚ فَاَنۭۡ بَتۡنَا بِهٖ حَدَآئِقَ ذَاتَ بَهۡجَةٍۚ مَا كَانَ لَكُمۡ اَنۡ تُنۭۡ بِتُوۡا شَجَرَهَاؕ ءَاِلٰهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِؕ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٌ يَّعۡدِلُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Amman khalaqas samaawaati wal arda wa anzala lakum minas samaaa'i maaa'an fa ambatnaa bihee hadaaa'iqa zaata bahjjah; maa kanna lakum an tumbitoo shajarahaa; 'a-ilaahum ma'al laah; bal hum qawmuny ya'diloon
ayahs.en: [More precisely], is He [not best] who created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you rain from the sky, causing to grow thereby gardens of joyful beauty which you could not [otherwise] have grown the trees thereof? Is there a deity with Allah? [No], but they are a people who ascribe equals [to Him].

ayahs.ar: اَمَّنۡ جَعَلَ الۡاَرۡضَ قَرَارًا وَّجَعَلَ خِلٰلَهَا٘ اَنۡهٰرًا وَّجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَجَعَلَ بَيۡنَ الۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ حَاجِزًاؕ ءَاِلٰهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِؕ بَلۡ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Ammann ja'alal arda qaraaranw wa ja'ala khilaalahaaa anhaaranw wa ja'ala lahaa rawaasiya wa ja'ala bainal bahraini haajizaa; 'a-ilaahumma'allah; bal aksaruhum la ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: Is He [not best] who made the earth a stable ground and placed within it rivers and made for it firmly set mountains and placed between the two seas a barrier? Is there a deity with Allah? [No], but most of them do not know.

ayahs.ar: اَمَّنۡ يُّجِيۡبُ الۡمُضۡطَرَّ اِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكۡشِفُ السُّوۡٓءَ وَيَجۡعَلُكُمۡ خُلَفَآءَ الۡاَرۡضِؕ ءَاِلٰهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِؕ قَلِيۡلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Ammany-yujeebul mud tarra izaa da'aahu wa yakshifussooo'a wa yaj'alukum khula faaa'al ardi 'a-ilaahum ma'al laahi qaleelam maa tazak karoon
ayahs.en: Is He [not best] who responds to the desperate one when he calls upon Him and removes evil and makes you inheritors of the earth? Is there a deity with Allah? Little do you remember.

ayahs.ar: اَمَّنۡ يَّهۡدِيۡكُمۡ فِيۡ ظُلُمٰتِ الۡبَرِّ وَالۡبَحۡرِ وَمَنۡ يُّرۡسِلُ الرِّيٰحَ بُشۡرًاۭ بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ رَحۡمَتِهٖؕ ءَاِلٰهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِؕ تَعٰلَي اللّٰهُ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Ammany-yahdeekum fee zulumaatil barri wal bahri wa many yursilu riyaaha bushram baina yadai rahmatih; 'a-ilaahum ma'al laah; Ta'aalal laahu 'ammaa yushrikoon
ayahs.en: Is He [not best] who guides you through the darknesses of the land and sea and who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy? Is there a deity with Allah? High is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.

ayahs.ar: اَمَّنۡ يَّبۡدَؤُا الۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيۡدُهٗ وَمَنۡ يَّرۡزُقُكُمۡ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ ءَاِلٰهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِؕ قُلۡ هَاتُوۡا بُرهَانَكُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Ammmany-yabda'ul khalqa summa yu'eeduhoo wa many-yarzuqukum minas sammaaa'i wal ard; 'a-ilaahum ma'allah; qul haatoo burhaanakum in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.en: Is He [not best] who begins creation and then repeats it and who provides for you from the heaven and earth? Is there a deity with Allah? Say, "Produce your proof, if you should be truthful."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ لَّا يَعۡلَمُ مَنۡ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ الۡغَيۡبَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُؕ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ اَيَّانَ يُبۡعَثُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul laa ya'lamu mman fis sammaawaati wal ardil ghaiba illal laah; wa maa yash'uroona aiyaana yub'asoon
ayahs.en: Say, "None in the heavens and earth knows the unseen except Allah, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected."

ayahs.ar: بَلِ ادّٰرَكَ عِلۡمُهُمۡ فِي الۡاٰخِرَةِࣞ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِيۡ شَكٍّ مِّنۡهَاࣞ بَلۡ هُمۡ مِّنۡهَا عَمُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Balid daaraka 'ilmuhum fil Aakhirah; bal hum fee shakkim minhaa bal hum minhaa 'amoon
ayahs.en: Rather, their knowledge is arrested concerning the Hereafter. Rather, they are in doubt about it. Rather, they are, concerning it, blind.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡ٘ا ءَاِذَا كُنَّا تُرٰبًا وَّاٰبَآؤُنَا٘ اَئِنَّا لَمُخۡرَجُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal lazeena kafarooo 'a-izaa kunnaa turaabanw wa aabaaa'unaaa a'innaa lamukhrajoon
ayahs.en: And those who disbelieve say, "When we have become dust as well as our forefathers, will we indeed be brought out [of the graves]?

ayahs.ar: لَقَدۡ وُعِدۡنَا هٰذَا نَحۡنُ وَاٰبَآؤُنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلُۙ اِنۡ هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا٘ اَسَاطِيۡرُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Laqad wu'idnaa haazaa nahnu wa aabaaa'unaa min qablu in haazaaa illaaa asaateerul awwaleen
ayahs.en: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before. This is not but legends of the former peoples."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ سِيۡرُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَانۡظُرُوۡا كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul seeroo fil ardi fanzuroo kaifa kaana 'aaqibatul mujremeen
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Travel through the land and observe how was the end of the criminals."

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا تَكُنۡ فِيۡ ضَيۡقٍ مِّمَّا يَمۡكُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laa tahzan 'alaihim wa laa takun fee daiqim mimmaa yamkuroon
ayahs.en: And grieve not over them or be in distress from what they conspire.

ayahs.ar: وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ مَتٰي هٰذَا الۡوَعۡدُ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa yaqooloona mataa haazal wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.en: And they say, "When is [the fulfillment of] this promise, if you should be truthful?"

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ عَسٰ٘ي اَنۡ يَّكُوۡنَ رَدِفَ لَكُمۡ بَعۡضُ الَّذِيۡ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul 'asaaa any-yakoona radifa lakum ba'dul lazee tasta'jiloon
ayahs.en: Say, "Perhaps it is close behind you - some of that for which you are impatient.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُوۡ فَضۡلٍ عَلَي النَّاسِ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa innna Rabbaka lazoo fadlin 'alan naasi wa laakina aksarahum laa yashkuroon
ayahs.en: And indeed, your Lord is full of bounty for the people, but most of them do not show gratitude."

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُوۡرُهُمۡ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa inna Rabbaka la ya'lamu maa tukinnu sudooruhum wa maa yu'linoon
ayahs.en: And indeed, your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا مِنۡ غَآئِبَةٍ فِي السَّمَآءِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ اِلَّا فِيۡ كِتٰبٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa min ghaaa'ibatin fis samaaa'i wal ardi illaa fee kitaabimm mubeen
ayahs.en: And there is nothing concealed within the heaven and the earth except that it is in a clear Register.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ هٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ يَقُصُّ عَلٰي بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ اَكۡثَرَ الَّذِيۡ هُمۡ فِيۡهِ يَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Inna haazal Qur-aana yaqussu 'alaa Baneee israaa'eela aksaral lazee hum feehi yakhtalifoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, this Qur'an relates to the Children of Israel most of that over which they disagree.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّهٗ لَهُدًي وَّرَحۡمَةٌ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa innahoo lahudanw wa rahmatul lilmu'mineen
ayahs.en: And indeed, it is guidance and mercy for the believers.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقۡضِيۡ بَيۡنَهُمۡ بِحُكۡمِهٖۚ وَهُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡعَلِيۡمُۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Inna Rabbaka yaqdee bainahum bihukmih; wa Huwal 'Azeezul 'Aleem
ayahs.en: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them by His [wise] judgement. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.

ayahs.ar: فَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَي اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّكَ عَلَي الۡحَقِّ الۡمُبِيۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Fatawakkal 'alal laahi innaka 'alal haqqil mubeen
ayahs.en: So rely upon Allah; indeed, you are upon the clear truth.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّكَ لَا تُسۡمِعُ الۡمَوۡتٰي وَلَا تُسۡمِعُ الصُّمَّ الدُّعَآءَ اِذَا وَلَّوۡا مُدۡبِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innaka laa tusmi'ul mawtaa wa laa tusmi'us summad du'aaa izaa wallaw mudbireen
ayahs.en: Indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they have turned their backs retreating.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَنۡتَ بِهٰدِي الۡعُمۡيِ عَنۡ ضَلٰلَتِهِمۡؕ اِنۡ تُسۡمِعُ اِلَّا مَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنُ بِاٰيٰتِنَا فَهُمۡ مُّسۡلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa anta bihaadil 'umyi 'an dalaalatihim in tusmi'u illaa mai yu'minu bi aayaatinaa fahum muslimoon
ayahs.en: And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [submitting to Allah].

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا وَقَعَ الۡقَوۡلُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ اَخۡرَجۡنَا لَهُمۡ دَآبَّةً مِّنَ الۡاَرۡضِ تُكَلِّمُهُمۡۙ اَنَّ النَّاسَ كَانُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا لَا يُوۡقِنُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa waqa'al qawhu 'alaihim akhrajnaa lahum daabbatam minal ardi tukal limuhum annan naasa kaanoo bi aayaatinaa laa yooqinoon
ayahs.en: And when the word befalls them, We will bring forth for them a creature from the earth speaking to them, [saying] that the people were, of Our verses, not certain [in faith].

ayahs.ar: وَيَوۡمَ نَحۡشُرُ مِنۡ كُلِّ اُمَّةٍ فَوۡجًا مِّمَّنۡ يُّكَذِّبُ بِاٰيٰتِنَا فَهُمۡ يُوۡزَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa Yawma nahshuru min kulli ummmatin fawjam mim many-yukazzibu bi Aayaatinaa fahum yooza'oon
ayahs.en: And [warn of] the Day when We will gather from every nation a company of those who deny Our signs, and they will be [driven] in rows

ayahs.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا جَآءُوۡ قَالَ اَكَذَّبۡتُمۡ بِاٰيٰتِيۡ وَلَمۡ تُحِيۡطُوۡا بِهَا عِلۡمًا اَمَّاذَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Hattaaa izaa jaaa'oo qaala akazzabtum bi Aayaatee wa lam tuheetoo bihaa 'ilman ammaazaa kuntum ta'maloon
ayahs.en: Until, when they arrive [at the place of Judgement], He will say, "Did you deny My signs while you encompassed them not in knowledge, or what [was it that] you were doing?"

ayahs.ar: وَوَقَعَ الۡقَوۡلُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ بِمَا ظَلَمُوۡا فَهُمۡ لَا يَنۡطِقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa waqa'al qawlu 'alaihim bimaa zalamoo fahum laa yantiqoon
ayahs.en: And the decree will befall them for the wrong they did, and they will not [be able to] speak.

ayahs.ar: اَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اَنَّا جَعَلۡنَا الَّيۡلَ لِيَسۡكُنُوۡا فِيۡهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبۡصِرًاؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Alam yaraw annaa ja'alnal laila li yaskunoo feehi wannahaara mubsiraa; inna fee zaalika la Aayaatil liqaw miny-yu'minoon
ayahs.en: Do they not see that We made the night that they may rest therein and the day giving sight? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.

ayahs.ar: وَيَوۡمَ يُنۡفَخُ فِي الصُّوۡرِ فَفَزِعَ مَنۡ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَنۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ اِلَّا مَنۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُؕ وَكُلٌّ اَتَوۡهُ دٰخِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa Yawma yunfakhu fis Soori fafazi'a man fis samaawaati wa man fil ardi illaa man shaaa'al laah; wa kullun atawhu daakhireen
ayahs.en: And [warn of] the Day the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will be terrified except whom Allah wills. And all will come to Him humbled.

ayahs.ar: وَتَرَي الۡجِبَالَ تَحۡسَبُهَا جَامِدَةً وَّهِيَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ السَّحَابِؕ صُنۡعَ اللّٰهِ الَّذِيۡ٘ اَتۡقَنَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍؕ اِنَّهٗ خَبِيۡرٌۭ بِمَا تَفۡعَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa taral jibaala tahsabuhaa jaamidatanw wa hiya tamurru marras sahaab; sun'al laahil lazeee atqana kulla shai'; innahoo khabeerum bimaa taf'aloon
ayahs.en: And you see the mountains, thinking them rigid, while they will pass as the passing of clouds. [It is] the work of Allah, who perfected all things. Indeed, He is Acquainted with that which you do.

ayahs.ar: مَنۡ جَآءَ بِالۡحَسَنَةِ فَلَهٗ خَيۡرٌ مِّنۡهَاۚ وَهُمۡ مِّنۡ فَزَعٍ يَّوۡمَئِذٍ اٰمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Man jaaa'a bilhasanati falahoo khairum minhaa wa hum min faza'iny Yawma'izin aaminoon
ayahs.en: Whoever comes [at Judgement] with a good deed will have better than it, and they, from the terror of that Day, will be safe.

ayahs.ar: وَمَنۡ جَآءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَكُبَّتۡ وُجُوۡهُهُمۡ فِي النَّارِؕ هَلۡ تُجۡزَوۡنَ اِلَّا مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa man jaaa'a bissai yi'ati fakubbat wujoohuhum fin Naari hal tujzawna illaa maa kuntum ta'maloon
ayahs.en: And whoever comes with an evil deed - their faces will be overturned into the Fire, [and it will be said], "Are you recompensed except for what you used to do?"

ayahs.ar: اِنَّمَا٘ اُمِرۡتُ اَنۡ اَعۡبُدَ رَبَّ هٰذِهِ الۡبَلۡدَةِ الَّذِيۡ حَرَّمَهَا وَلَهٗ كُلُّ شَيۡءٍؗ وَّاُمِرۡتُ اَنۡ اَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡمُسۡلِمِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Innamaaa umirtu an a'buda Rabba haazihil baldatil lazee harramahaa wa lahoo kullu shai'inw wa umirtu an akoona minal muslimeen
ayahs.en: [Say, O Muhammad], "I have only been commanded to worship the Lord of this city, who made it sacred and to whom [belongs] all things. And I am commanded to be of the Muslims [those who submit to Allah]

ayahs.ar: وَاَنۡ اَتۡلُوَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَۚ فَمَنِ اهۡتَدٰي فَاِنَّمَا يَهۡتَدِيۡ لِنَفۡسِهٖۚ وَمَنۡ ضَلَّ فَقُلۡ اِنَّمَا٘ اَنَا مِنَ الۡمُنۡذِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa an atluwal Qur-aana famanih tadaa fa innnamaa yahtadee linafsihee wa man dalla faqul innamaaa ana minal munzireen
ayahs.en: And to recite the Qur'an." And whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] himself; and whoever strays - say, "I am only [one] of the warners."

ayahs.ar: وَقُلِ الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ سَيُرِيۡكُمۡ اٰيٰتِهٖ فَتَعۡرِفُوۡنَهَاؕ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qulil hamdu lillaahi sa yureekum Aayaatihee fata'ri foonahaa; wa maa Rabbuka bighaaflin 'ammaa ta'maloon
ayahs.en: And say, "[All] praise is [due] to Allah. He will show you His signs, and you will recognize them. And your Lord is not unaware of what you do."
